observation.rules: You are the sender in a trust exchange. The sender gets 10 credits and can transfer some. Sent credits are multiplied by 2 (rounded down). The receiver may return any received amount; both keep what remains. Pairs change by a seeded round schedule. A promise is a minimum future transfer next time you act, scored only if you have enough credits available. Report states your private signal. On a sender turn, forecast predicts the partner's return divided by received credits; it is scored when received credits are positive. On receiver turns forecast is null. Target selects a message recipient; the exchange partner is set by the rules.
